notes.title: Toy Tactics Release
notes.notes:
Dear community,

After eight years, yes eight, in development, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772530/Toy_Tactics/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=cross-post&utm_campaign=lip]Toy Tactics[/url] has been released. 

[previewyoutube=OOgo8R1bAGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Toy Tactics is an RTS where you can draw your formation. Play with five armies, strategize to solve tactical puzzles, defend from the Dragur, and conquer all battles.

The game has:
[list]
[*] 20 hours of gameplay
[*] Sandbox, Squirmish and Mercenaries mode
[*] Online Co-Op and 1vs1
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772530/Toy_Tactics/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=cross-post&utm_campaign=lip]The game has a 30% Launch Discount. Buy it now![/url]

The Joystick Ventures Team 
xoxo

notes.title: OS X Version now Availabe!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Lost in Play for OS X is now available for download. LIP's Mac version has been requested since we started, and we are so happy to finally be able to provide it for Mac users.

Have fun playing! 

Love,
Team Happy Juice

notes.title: Patch update notes for version 1.0.63
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Enjoy playing!

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Traditional Chinese support for the keys remapping screen

Bug fixes:
- Update to the save system that caused a few players to lose some progress (sorry about that!)
- Some minor audio and visual fixes

Thanks for getting Lost in Play! 

The Happy Juice Team
